messages:
lucy: FYI I opened a small docs PR clarifying how tiered metering rounds after micro-batch aggregation for many tiny embedding calls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5301

kevin: Thanks. This came up with a customer yesterday. Can you add the minimal repro and a direct remediation example so support can link it?

lucy: Added a 2-row table showing the math and a short repro summary: multiple near-simultaneous single-vector embedding requests are grouped into transient micro-batches by the serving runtime; metering sums per-batch and then applies tier rounding, which can diverge from naive per-call rounded totals.

mira: What do we recommend customers do if they need per-call accounting? We should be explicit about SDK and console pointers.

lucy: Recommendation: request per-call semantics via header or use the bulk API. I added a compact JS + curl snippet using the header `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call`. JS example included in PR:

```js
// request per-call billing semantics
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-billing-intent': 'per-call'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-tiny', input: ['a','b','c'] })
});
```
\nkevin: I'll add a short note to the JS SDK README showing how to set the header via options and a curl one-liner for support. Also confirming runtime honors the header on staging. Filing RUNTIME-811 to ensure the header is emitted in metering events for audits.

tara: Tiny copy edits: change heading "Workarounds" -> "When to request per-call semantics"; replace "opt out" language with "request per-call semantics"; tighten the table width. Also update the console panel path: old docs pointed to "Metering > Tiered Usage"; current Console path is "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)".

lucy: Done all of the above and pushed. I also added a short migration note to the console panel rename section.

docs-bot: PR opened by lucy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5301 — labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

tara: I'll review and tidy the snippet formatting this afternoon; if no issues I'll merge before Friday deploy.

kevin: Leaving a cross-link request: once merged, please add a short line in the SDK FAQ linking back to this doc so support can reference it.

lucy: Will do. Leaving thread open for last-minute changes. :thumbsup:
